module_summary: Two-register instruction latch: a 2-bit fetch code selects which 8-bit register captures data; ins_p1 is split into opcode/address fields, ins_p2 passed through.

anchors.name: ins_p1
anchors.why: Holds instruction from register source; sliced into ins opcode and ad1 address.

anchors.name: ins_p2
anchors.why: Holds instruction byte from RAM/ROM source; drives ad2.

anchors.name: fetch
anchors.why: Decoded load enable: 01 loads ins_p1, 10 loads ins_p2, else hold.

groups.name: instruction_registers
groups.description: Fetch-selected instruction registers with field split outputs.
